# Getting Started with Create React App

This project was bootstrapped with [Create React App](https://github.com/facebook/create-react-app).

## Available Scripts

In the project directory, you can run:

### `npm start`

Runs the app in the development mode.\
Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to view it in your browser.

The page will reload when you make changes.\
You may also see any lint errors in the console.

### `npm test`

Launches the test runner in the interactive watch mode.\
See the section about [running tests](https://facebook.github.io/create-react-app/docs/running-tests) for more information.

### `npm run build`

Builds the app for production to the `build` folder.\
It correctly bundles React in production mode and optimizes the build for the best performance.

The build is minified and the filenames include the hashes.\
Your app is ready to be deployed!

See the section about [deployment](https://facebook.github.io/create-react-app/docs/deployment) for more information.

### `npm run eject`

**Note: this is a one-way operation. Once you `eject`, you can't go back!**

If you aren't satisfied with the build tool and configuration choices, you can `eject` at any time. This command will remove the single build dependency from your project.

Instead, it will copy all the configuration files and the transitive dependencies (webpack, Babel, ESLint, etc) right into your project so you have full control over them. All of the commands except `eject` will still work, but they will point to the copied scripts so you can tweak them. At this point you're on your own.

You don't have to ever use `eject`. The curated feature set is suitable for small and middle deployments, and you shouldn't feel obligated to use this feature. However we understand that this tool wouldn't be useful if you couldn't customize it when you are ready for it.

## Learn More

You can learn more in the [Create React App documentation](https://facebook.github.io/create-react-app/docs/getting-started).

HoldWise AI

Privacy Policy

Effective date: August 24, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Storm And Me LLC ("we," "us," or "our") handles information when you use HoldWise AI (the "App").

Information we may collect

  • Account information you provide when creating or using an account, such as an email address and authentication-related information.
  • App activity and progress, including game selections, practice activity, lesson progress, strategy interactions, preferences, and similar in-app activity needed to provide HoldWise features.
  • Purchase and entitlement information needed to determine whether HoldWise Premium is active. Payments are processed by Google Play or the applicable app store; we do not receive your full payment-card number.
  • Technical information such as device/app version, crash or diagnostic information, and basic security or performance data when provided by platform services.
  • AI coaching input you choose to submit when using AI-powered coaching features, together with relevant game or strategy context needed to generate a response.

How we use information

We use information to operate HoldWise, provide gameplay, practice and learning features, deliver AI coaching, save progress and preferences, verify Premium access, restore purchases, improve stability and security, respond to support requests, and comply with legal obligations.

AI-powered features

When you use AI coaching, the text and game context you submit may be sent to service providers that help generate the requested response. Do not submit passwords, financial account details, or other highly sensitive information in AI coaching prompts.

Purchases

HoldWise may offer subscriptions or one-time Premium purchases through Google Play or another platform store. The store processes payment information under its own privacy terms. HoldWise receives purchase status and related identifiers needed to unlock, restore, and manage Premium access.

Sharing of information

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with service providers that support authentication, hosting, analytics/diagnostics, AI functionality, and app-store billing, only as needed to provide and secure the App. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect users, our rights, or the security of the App.

Data retention and deletion

We retain information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, including providing the service, maintaining security, meeting legal obligations, and resolving disputes. HoldWise includes account/data deletion functionality where applicable. You may also contact us through the website below to request assistance with deletion.

Security

We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards designed to protect information. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, so absolute security cannot be guaranteed.

Children

HoldWise is not designed to collect personal information from children in violation of applicable law. If you believe a child has provided personal information improperly, contact us so we can review and address the issue.

Card-game and gambling clarification

HoldWise is designed for card-game learning, practice, strategy, and entertainment. It does not provide real-money wagering or cash-prize gambling.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as HoldWise changes. The effective date above will be revised when material updates are published.

Contact

Storm And Me LLC
Website: https://stormandmeofficial.com/

This page is publicly accessible and is intended to serve as the official privacy policy for HoldWise AI.

Delete your RepPurpose account.

⚡Storm And Me LLC

RepPurpose · Privacy

RepPurpose Privacy Policy

This policy explains the information RepPurpose uses to personalize workouts, meal logging, scanning, progress, coaching preferences, and account features.

Effective August 19, 2026 · Storm And Me LLC

Who operates RepPurpose

RepPurpose is operated by Storm And Me LLC. RepPurpose is a fitness and wellness-planning application for adults. It provides personalized workout planning, progress tracking, meal logging, camera-assisted analysis, and optional sound, haptic, and voice-coaching features.

Account and profile information

When you create and use an account, RepPurpose may process your account email and the fitness information you choose to provide, such as age, height, weight, goals, experience level, available workout time, workout schedule, disclosed limitations, and coaching preferences. These details are used to tailor the experience you request.

Workout and meal information

RepPurpose may store user-owned workout history, completed workout details, and meal entries that you choose to confirm and save. Nutrition and image-based food estimates can be uncertain and are presented as estimates rather than medical or laboratory measurements.

Camera, photos, and your permission

Camera or photo access is requested only when you choose a feature that needs it, such as scanning your environment or analyzing a meal. After you select a photo, RepPurpose identifies OpenAI as the analysis recipient and asks for your explicit permission before sending that photo. Your consent resets when you choose a different photo. Only after you agree is the selected image sent through a protected RepPurpose server function to OpenAI for the specific analysis you requested. RepPurpose does not save the selected analysis photo to your RepPurpose account.

OpenAI-assisted analysis

RepPurpose uses OpenAI for the environment-scan and meal-photo analysis features. When you explicitly consent for a selected photo, RepPurpose may send that image and the request context needed to produce the requested analysis to OpenAI. If you do not consent, RepPurpose does not send that selected photo for AI analysis. AI results can be incomplete or wrong. RepPurpose is not a physician, dietitian, physical therapist, or diagnostic service, and its estimates and coaching are not medical care.

Sound, haptics, and voice coaching

Sound effects, device haptics, and text-to-speech coaching are optional controls in your RepPurpose profile. The current app configuration does not request microphone access for these playback features. You can turn sound, haptics, and voice coaching on or off from the You screen.

How information is used

  • Authenticate your account and maintain your signed-in session.
  • Personalize workouts and coaching to the profile and preferences you provide.
  • Save workouts, confirmed meal entries, and progress you choose to keep.
  • Perform scan or meal analysis that you explicitly request and consent to.
  • Operate, secure, troubleshoot, and improve RepPurpose.
  • Process support, privacy, and account-deletion requests.

Service providers

RepPurpose uses infrastructure and platform services including Supabase for authentication, protected server functions, and user-owned application data; OpenAI for the photo-analysis features described above; and Apple, Google, Expo, and applicable device or app-store services. Storm And Me LLC requires service providers that receive RepPurpose user data to handle that data with the same or an equivalent level of protection described in this policy and required by applicable privacy obligations.

Sale and advertising use of fitness data

Storm And Me LLC does not sell your RepPurpose fitness profile, workout history, meal entries, or private scan content. Those categories are not used by Storm And Me LLC to build third-party advertising profiles.

Security and account separation

RepPurpose uses authenticated access controls for user-owned fitness profiles, workouts, and meal entries. The production database is configured so normal signed-in application access is limited to the authenticated user's own rows. Server-only administrative credentials are not embedded in the mobile application.

Your deletion controls

Signed-in users can initiate permanent account deletion inside RepPurpose from the You screen. If the app is no longer installed or accessible, you can also submit an external deletion request from the Storm And Me website. Deleting the authenticated RepPurpose account removes the user-owned fitness profile, workouts, and meal entries associated with that account through the application's deletion workflow. Limited records may be retained only when reasonably necessary for legal, security, fraud-prevention, dispute, or transaction-record obligations.

Open the RepPurpose account-deletion page →

Retention

Account and user-owned RepPurpose data are retained while needed to provide the service and until deleted through available account controls, subject to limited legal, security, fraud-prevention, or operational retention requirements. Public deletion-request records are retained only as reasonably necessary to verify, process, and document the request.

Adults

RepPurpose is currently intended for adults age 18 or older. It is not designed as a children's fitness or social application.

Changes to this policy

If RepPurpose materially changes its account system, data flows, AI providers, analytics, advertising technology, or other privacy-relevant features, this policy and applicable store disclosures will be updated as appropriate.

Contact

For privacy questions about RepPurpose, use the Storm & Me Official contact page. Do not send passwords, authentication codes, payment-card numbers, government identification documents, or detailed medical records through ordinary support messages.

Contact Storm & Me →

← Wick

Wick Privacy Policy

Effective September 1, 2026 · Storm And Me LLC

Short version: Wick is designed to work without an account. Your social-energy logs and optional notes stay in local app storage unless you deliberately export a backup. Storm And Me LLC does not sell your personal data.

Information Wick stores

Wick stores your lantern level, check-ins, optional notes, preferences, and related app settings locally on your device. The app does not require you to create an account.

Information sent to Storm And Me

Wick does not send your journal history, check-ins, or optional notes to Storm And Me servers. Version 1.0.0 does not include advertising or analytics SDKs.

Glow purchases

Glow is an optional one-time in-app purchase. Purchases are processed by Google Play on Android or the App Store on iOS. Wick receives the store entitlement result needed to unlock Glow. Storm And Me does not receive or store your payment-card details.

Export and import

If Glow is unlocked, you may choose to export a Wick JSON backup or import one. Export occurs only when you initiate it. You control where the exported file is saved or shared.

Device backups

Android application backup is disabled by Wick. Device-transfer or operating-system behavior outside Wick may be controlled by your platform provider. Wick's explicit export/import tools remain under your control.

Children

Wick is a general lifestyle and reflection app and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children through Wick.

Medical disclaimer

Wick is a personal reflection and wellness tool. It is not a medical device, diagnostic service, or substitute for professional care.

Changes

If Wick later adds cloud sync, accounts, analytics, advertising, crash reporting, or other data collection, this policy and the applicable store disclosures will be updated before that functionality is released.

Contact

Wick is published by Storm And Me LLC. For support or privacy questions, use the Wick support page.

© 2026 Storm And Me LLC
